statement: Small teams that publish a command-line tool lose users at install: the tool installs one way on one machine and another way on the next, and the first run fails.
segment: Small teams of one to five people who publish developer tools
cost: Users who give up before the first run, and support time spent on install problems
workarounds: A long install section in the README
A container image users must learn to run
why_now: More small teams publish tools now that agents help them write the code, so more of them meet the install problem.

evidence.summary: In an invented sample of issue trackers, install problems are the most common first issue a new user opens.

source.title: Example sample, invented for this fixture

forms.statement: A new user installs the tool and the first run fails with an error they cannot read.
